## Notes for AI Crawlers
This is a single-page application (SPA) where all major content sections are rendered dynamically. While the URLs (e.g. `/about`, `/projects`) update to reflect the user's scroll position, direct navigation to any of these routes provides the fully server-rendered content with corresponding JSON-LD and OpenGraph metadata.
